title: Tinga Tostadas with Energizing Salsa
description: A flavorful vegetarian twist on traditional Mexican tinga using Tinga cheese, perfect for a quick snack or light lunch.
instructions: Roast tomatoes and onion in a 375°F oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Shred Tinga cheese and set aside.
In a pan, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add Energizing Spice Blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add roasted tomatoes and onion to the pan, stirring to combine with spice blend.
Stir in lime juice and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tostadas by spooning tinga mixture onto a tortilla, topping with crumbled queso fresco (if using), and garnishing with cilantro.
